additional_info.subject: RE: [External] ID0408123-DC/Si-D/NL-[multiple] Retrofitted with longer cables CRM:00921001566
additional_info.body:
Hello Team,
Hope you are doing well.
We have received a request from
(Brier59)
in your region regarding retrofitting with longer cables for the below-mentioned chargers. Currently, the cables are 3.1m, and they would like to upgrade to the 5m variant.
MP / P4 170000481
: 1x CCS & 1x CHAdeMO
2. MP / P4 170000480
: 2x CCS
The customer has also requested an offer with a cost specification for this change. Please reach out to the customer and proceed accordingly.
Additionally, upon reviewing our asset database, we found that the product is no longer under warranty since
04/07/2024
. As a result, we are transferring the case to the regional queue.
Kindly communicate with the customer and provide the necessary service support and/or offer. We have already informed the customer that a regional representative will be in touch shortly.
Should you require further remote or expert support, please request it via PMD.
For additional information, please visit the Service Collaboration SharePoint. If you need assistance with ordering Expert Support, feel free to reach out to Sousa, Afonso (SI E CS SD) at
afonso-sousa@siemens.com
or Teodoso, Rui (SI E CS SD ES) at
rui.teodoso@siemens.com
.
Regards,
Beerpal Singh
eMobility Support
Please do not change the subject line with replying back to this email.
